title: Passive-region circuit-breaker chaos rehearsal and backfill assertion
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Run a focused, repeatable rehearsal targeting passive-region promotion flows that exercise circuit-breaker hysteresis and the incremental KV backfill path. This ticket defines the scope, success criteria, automated validators, and rollback signals for a scheduled chaos rehearsal against the passive region that mimics slow network egress and partial dependency failures (S3 read latency, control plane rate limiting). The goal is to validate that: 1) traffic siphon and canary fencing prevent cascading load on primary region, 2) circuit breakers trigger predictable load-shedding and prioritization, and 3) backfill/replication mechanisms restore parity within defined SLO windows without data loss.
acceptance_criteria: Scheduled rehearsal completes end-to-end in production-like staging with no manual hotfixes
Primary-region tail latency increase <= 15% during simulated promotion window
KV consistency check (sha256 fingerprints) shows 100% match after backfill within 30 minutes
Circuit-breaker metrics (open_count, trip_rate) match expected thresholds documented below
Post-rehearsal postmortem and runbook edits published within 72 hours
runbook_steps: Pre-run: Tag traffic and activate read-only routing for staging tenants. Ensure snapshot and incremental backup succeed (backup job id in artifacts).
Step 1: Throttle control-plane API to passive region (50% RPS, 200ms added latency) for 2 minutes to prime circuit breakers.
Step 2: Inject S3 GET latency (simulate 5xxs and 2s latency) affecting cold KV rehydration calls.
Step 3: Trigger passive-region promotion in canary mode to 5% of test origin traffic.
Step 4: Monitor fencing signals and allow automatic siphon; do not intervene unless safety gates fail.
Step 5: After 10 minutes, promote to 25% then 100% for test tenants if metrics are green.
Step 6: Verify KV backfill completes, run fingerprint comparison queries, and assert sequence continuity for last 24h of writes.
Rollback: If primary latency > 2x baseline for 5 consecutive minutes OR data-drift > 0 pending operations, immediately revert routing and escalate on-call.
Post-run: Run housekeeping: re-enable full load, collect traces, garbage-collect temporary snapshots, and tag metrics for the postmortem.
verification_queries: SELECT count(*) FROM write_log WHERE region='passive' AND timestamp > '<promotion_start>'
SELECT sha256_agg(fingerprint) FROM kv_index WHERE region IN ('primary','passive') AND window='30m'
telemetry_checks: Circuit breaker open_rate < 0.8 for high-priority routes
Tier-0 request success rate >= 99.5% during promotion
KV backfill lag (seconds) trending to zero within 30 minutes
Control plane API 5xx spike < 1% of baseline
Error budget burn for region SLA does not exceed 20% during exercise
risks: Transient spike in primary tail latency leading to customer-visible errors if fencing delays are misconfigured
Incomplete backfill due to throttled S3 causing stranded writes
Runbook ambiguity around circuit-breaker hysteresis could cause premature rollback
On-call cognitive load if simultaneous incidents in unrelated subsystems occur during rehearsal
